hypothesis.claim: The zero-credit dP layout bridge can be incorporated into one LibNC-free complete 65,536-symbol causal replay whose O, K, F, and S arms exactly reproduce retained integer probabilities and every future-affecting checkpoint without captured teacher gradients as treatment inputs.
hypothesis.falsification: After complete input and implementation closure exists, any population omission, hidden treatment input, dP bridge mismatch, O or F oracle mismatch, K versus O mismatch, dead shifted control, nondeterministic output, dependency escape, or resource failure rejects the integrated implementation. Missing closure keeps the experiment dormant and supplies no scientific verdict.

changedMechanism: Replace the retired isolated-primitive ladder with one complete open first-half forward, loss, backward, midpoint Adam update, state rebuild, and second-half replay; apply and independently re-verify the fixed dP serialization bridge only at its integrated checkpoint.
invariants: The v3 isolated dP source-layout gate remains failed with zero credit; this experiment cannot relabel or rescue it.
The F and O traces fix all 65,536 row, symbol, tree, truth-path, branch, segment, and execution coordinates before implementation.
Captured teacher gradients, parameters after update, hidden states, and caches may be read only as comparators after the corresponding open treatment payload is complete.
No additional isolated backward primitive, layout correction, tolerance, layer subset, rank, scale, or parameter sweep is authorized.
Every future-affecting parameter, optimizer value, recurrent state, attention state, cache, cursor, truth position, and pending update enters canonical state hashes.
Compression, archive, package-score, and objective credit remain exactly zero even if parity passes.

controls.definition: Open output-head-only trajectory must reproduce the immutable O probability oracle and every bound O checkpoint.
Execute complete bookkeeping and state rebuild while committing only the O update; K must equal O at every probability and future-affecting state checkpoint.
Execute the complete open full-model first-half backward, midpoint Adam update, rebuild, and second-half trajectory; F must reproduce the immutable F oracle.
Run identical F machinery after the preregistered 257-segment cyclic reassignment of first-half truth-to-update associations; the control must be live and must not equal F.

At the integrated top-attention dP checkpoint, retain the open state,head,stream,key payload, materialize the fixed state,stream,head,key view independently, and require exact comparator identity without tolerance.

population.selection: All 65,536 immutable rows, 1,024 contiguous 64-symbol segments, and 917,527 truth-path branches in the retained F/O trace pair.
population.coordinate: Original transformed-symbol ordinal; first half is positions 0 through 31 and second half is positions 32 through 63 within each frozen segment.

availableInformation: Content-addressed initial model, Adam, recurrent, attention, cache, population, and truth state once the missing input lock is materialized.
Already decoded first-half truths at their original causal positions.
The open treatment's own forward activations and partial backward values.
Comparator tensors only after the corresponding treatment payload and its hash are committed.
forbiddenInformation: Captured teacher gradients or post-update state as treatment inputs.
Future truths, future probabilities, fitted scale, fitted permutation, tolerance, selected segments, or selected layers.
A LibNC or NNCP executable, shared object, service, network endpoint, or unbound generated artifact during treatment execution.
Any partial HORIZON scientific output or state.

measurements.definition: The complete population, model, optimizer, state, oracle, implementation, build, and runtime lock validates before execution.
All 246 update-target gradients at every frozen update boundary are produced from open causal inputs and match their comparators exactly.
The integrated top-attention dP payload reproduces the bound source comparator after only the frozen head/stream serialization permutation.
All 65,536 rows and 917,527 branches execute exactly once in frozen order.
K and O are byte-identical at every probability and future-affecting state checkpoint.
Open F reproduces every integer probability and authoritative full-update checkpoint.
S executes the same geometry and differs from F on at least one update payload and downstream probability.
Two complete clean executions produce byte-identical payloads, checkpoint hashes, controls, and decision fields.
Single-core process-tree memory, scratch, runtime-root, dependency, network, and source-package checks all pass.
A launched execution has complete locked inputs but fails population, causality, arithmetic, replay, dependency, or resource validity before a parity verdict.
